newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel to redeem notes.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel to redeem notes.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Wednesday it is redeeming all of the 4-3/4 percent convertible subordinated notes due in the year 2000 at a redemption price of 102.714 percent plus accrued interest.
The redemption date will be December 30, 1996.
Currently, there is approximately $85.279 million outstanding in principal amount of the notes.
The conversion ratio is 80 shares of TWI common stock per $1,000 note, which equates to a conversion price of $12.50 a share.
Titan Wheel supplies mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway vehicles.
